thread:
Maria (partnerships): Quick sync — ACME hardware team asked for a private-offer that includes a renewal velocity incentive. They want to convert metered customers to a 12‑month commit. Thoughts on structure?
Sam (sales): Love. Do we want a flat % discount or a tiered commit ladder? They prefer predictability.
Tom (finance): From finance, we need a minimum ARR commitment. Suggest $120k annual commit as floor. Also include quarterly true-up clause.
Anya (legal): Legal: okay to do tiered discounts but must limit retroactive credits. Also need clear sunset/renewal language and rollback if usage drops >30%.
Lucas (ops): Ops: marketplace private offers require specific SKUs. We need to reserve capacity mapping; can do a 'burst' buffer but it counts toward commit. Also, notify about lead time for listing.
Priya (product): Product: For SI integration, propose milestone credits: 20% of first-year usage credited after integration & joint go-live. That helps SI uptake.
Maria (partnerships): So proposed offer: 12-mo commit ladder: 100k => 10% discount, 250k => 18%, 500k+ => 25%. Add 60-day ramp credit 15% for first 60 days and SI go-live credit 20% once integration passes smoke tests.
Sam (sales): Can we make the ramp credit conditional on usage hitting 30% of committed in 60 days? avoids abuse.
Tom (finance): Fine. Also include true-up every 90 days; any shortfall billed at list minus discount (no extra penalty).
Anya (legal): No penalties unless in special cases; simpler is net billing of difference at next invoice. Include audit rights and usage report cadence.
Lucas (ops): Tech detail: marketplace listing example:
```
SKU: redwood-dedicated-acme-100k
Term: 12 months
Discount: 10%
Ramp-credit: 15% applied to first invoice
```
Make sure to set quota expiration date for credits.
Priya (product): Metrics we need to track: commit attainment %, ramp conversion rate, SI activation date, 30/60/90 trends. We'll add these to partner dashboard.
Sam (sales): I'll draft customer-facing language for the partner — short bullet list + appendix with T&Cs.
Maria (partnerships): Perfect. Sam, can you post the draft by EOD Thu? Anya & Tom to review. Lucas & Priya, please confirm SKU naming and dashboard hooks by Fri.
DeployBot: Reminder: marketplace private-offer templates must be uploaded before publish; run `/marketplace validate` after draft is ready.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll compile and ping legal/finance in thread.
